_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (score rarely moves ±2 in 12h windows) plus unbroken price keeps the live rung at Hope; no breaker yet visible.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst wanted Complacency/HOLD while narrative gave no forward phase; consensus enforces Hope ±0 and HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC continues chopping with flat funding and fear_greed 50-65, score staying inside Hope band
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX/dvol expand with price breakdown and momentum/fear_greed rolling into Disbelief/Anxiety, or funding and 30d momentum rip into a blow-off profile
